edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the underlying dispute identified as [insert agreed description and, if applicable, case caption, court, and case number] (the “Dispute”), on the terms below.
edits.name: Limit settlement scope

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [Settlement Amount to be agreed] by bank transfer within 14 calendar days after execution of this Agreement by both parties. Plaintiff shall promptly provide bank instructions, which Defendant shall independently verify with Plaintiff or Plaintiff’s counsel through a previously established contact method before transfer. Payment is complete only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds. Defendant shall bear transfer fees so that Plaintiff receives the full Settlement Amount.
edits.name: Payment mechanics; quantum reserved

edits.text: 2. MUTUAL RELEASES AND DISMISSAL. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff and Defendant each release the other from all claims against the other arising from the Dispute and based on acts or omissions occurring on or before execution of this Agreement. These releases do not extend to unrelated claims or to rights or obligations under this Agreement. Within three business days after receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, the parties shall execute and file all documents necessary to dismiss with prejudice any pending litigation constituting the Dispute, with each party bearing its own legal fees and costs. No release shall take effect, and no dismissal shall be required, before such receipt.
edits.name: Dispute-limited mutual releases and post-payment dismissal
